title: Senior Product Designer
description:

We envision a world where everyone can authentically share their story through video, with no expertise needed. Within just 18 months of our launch, over 20 million creators and businesses have used OpusClip to enhance their social presence.

Obsess over customers

About The Role
We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to own and shape core product experiences at OpusClip. This is a role for a hands-on builder who can turn complex AI capabilities into intuitive, polished, and useful experiences, and drive the work from early exploration through launch and iteration.
You won’t just receive requirements and turn them into screens. You’ll help define the problems we solve, challenge assumptions, establish the product direction, and work closely with product and engineering to ship high-quality experiences quickly. You should be comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve, technology is constantly changing, and designers are expected to bring clarity and momentum.
We’re looking for an AI-native designer who actively uses AI throughout the design and development process. You’ll use AI tools and vibe-coding workflows to explore ideas, build functional prototypes, test interactions, and communicate solutions more effectively. A working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Git will help you collaborate directly with engineers and make small front-end improvements when needed.
This role requires strong product thinking, excellent visual and interaction design skills, curiosity, organization, and a high level of personal responsibility. You’ll be expected to identify opportunities, make thoughtful decisions, and move projects forward without waiting for detailed direction.
What You'll Do
Own product design end-to-end, from problem framing and user flows to polished, production-ready UI across our web and product surfaces.
Drive projects from concept to shipped: scope the work, set priorities, and move without waiting for direction.
Partner closely with product managers, engineers, AI researchers, and other stakeholders to define product direction, requirements, and priorities.
Go beyond executing requirements by identifying user problems, questioning assumptions, and proposing better product solutions.
Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity interfaces, interaction patterns, and detailed implementation specifications.
Get hands-on with the front end when it helps, use your working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Git to prototype, ship small fixes, and collaborate tightly with engineers instead of throwing designs over the wall.
Set and maintain design consistency, contributing to the systems and guidelines that hold as we scale.
Leverage AI tools to accelerate ideation, production, and iteration without compromising quality.
What We're Looking For
A strong track record in product design, with a portfolio of live, shipped work, not just concepts.
A genuine self-starter who thrives with autonomy, examples of projects you scoped, drove, and shipped largely on your own, with minimal direction.
Expert-level proficiency in Figma and modern design tooling, with an exceptional sense of layout, typography, interaction, and product thinking.
Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Git, comfortable prototyping in code, jumping in to fast-fix small front-end issues, and speaking the same language as engineers.
Fluency with AI creative and prototyping tools, and a point of view on how to use them (including vibe coding) to work faster and better.
Responsible, organized, and curious. You own your outcomes, keep your work structured, and stay hungry to learn and explore.
The judgment to balance craft with business goals and user needs.
Excellent communication and the ability to align design, product, and engineering as a partner and a leader.
Bonus: experience with animation or motion design tools (e.g., Rive, After Effects).
Why Join Us
Shape the brand of a fast-moving, globally recognized AI company at a pivotal moment.
Real creative ownership and the autonomy to lead — this is your workstream to define and drive.

Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a Creative Technologist to help define the next generation of AI-powered video creation at OpusClip. You'll work at the intersection of visual design, generative AI, storytelling, and workflow innovation—elevating AI-generated content from impressive to exceptional.
You have exceptional creative taste and a deep understanding of generative AI. You don't just generate assets—you refine, direct, and elevate them until every frame meets your standards.
You are naturally curious, constantly exploring new tools and techniques, and you enjoy building systems that turn creative intuition into scalable workflows.
Responsibilities
Partner closely with the AI team to improve the quality, consistency, and creative direction of AI-generated video content.
Develop prompting frameworks and generation workflows that consistently produce high-quality outputs at scale.
Create repeatable creative systems that capture and operationalize visual taste, design principles, and storytelling best practices.
Evaluate and refine AI-generated assets, identifying and correcting issues related to composition, motion, continuity, realism, and visual quality.
Experiment with emerging AI creative tools and technologies, translating new capabilities into compelling product and content experiences.
Collaborate across product, design, marketing, and AI teams to help shape the future of AI video creation.
Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience with generative AI tools for image, video, or creative content generation.
Excellent visual design, motion design, or creative direction instincts with a high standard for quality and detail.
Deep understanding of prompt engineering, creative workflows, and AI generation techniques.
Strong storytelling instincts with an understanding of pacing, narrative structure, and visual communication.
Ability to create scalable frameworks and processes rather than relying solely on one-off creative execution.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with rapidly evolving tools and workflows.
What Makes You Successful
You can quickly spot visual inconsistencies, quality issues, and creative opportunities that others miss.
You understand both the capabilities and limitations of today's AI models and know how to consistently push them further.
You naturally think in systems, workflows, and reusable frameworks that help teams scale creative output.
You combine artistic judgment with technical curiosity, constantly testing new tools and approaches.
You care deeply about the final product and are willing to iterate until the work reaches a high creative standard.
Nice to Have
Background in product design, visual design, motion graphics, creative technology, or related fields.
Experience building node-based workflows in ComfyUI, Fal, or similar AI infrastructure tools.
Previous experience in video production, film, advertising, gaming, or other creative industries.
The Details
Location: On-site in Mountain View, CA
Competitive salary, equity, and performance-based bonuses
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
Opportunity to help shape one of the fastest-moving categories in AI

You rarely review or critique your own AI-generated work for quality and consistency.
You view prompting as the entire job rather than one part of a larger creative process.
You prefer receiving fully defined briefs instead of building new systems and workflows from scratch.
